u0: No blue pyramid has been made yet. Active subtask: find the blue star, navigate through the rooms and doors, and perform pickup with an empty pocket; that pickup immediately converts the blue star into a blue pyramid in your pocket and advances to u1. If you are carrying another object, put it down first. Any action other than making the blue pyramid leaves you in u0.
u1: The blue pyramid has been made and is either in your pocket or already placed on the grid. Active subtask: use it to satisfy the goal by having the blue pyramid on the cell immediately to your map-right (east), then execute a forward or putdown action. If carrying it, face east toward a free floor cell and put it down; alternatively place it, then position yourself immediately west of it. If it is already placed, keep track of it and do not pick it up unless repositioning. This state continues until blue_pyramid_on_right fires.
u2: Terminal success state: the goal has fired, with the blue pyramid immediately to the agent's map-right, and the episode ends on that step. No further actions follow and no further reward is collected.
